cohort: Children and adolescents and young adults (AYA) aged 0-37 years in California
finding: Cesarean section was associated with a decreased risk of pediatric Burkitt lymphoma and pediatric T-cell NHL, while heavier birthweight was associated with an elevated risk of DLBCL in AYA.
